description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Modern Woodmen of America is a fraternal benefit society offering insurance, investment, and member-focused services. The Quality Assurance Software Development Engineer will execute manual and automated testing, validate requirements and data, identify defects and quality risks, and develop testing assets using SQL, APIs, scripts, and automation tools.
Software QA engineer executing regression, API, SQL, and data validation tests while building automated testing solutions

Responsibilities:
• Execute manual, regression, API, and data validation tests for assigned work items and maintain accurate, comprehensive test documentation
• Create and maintain test cases, test data, defect details, and basic supporting test documentation
• Collaborate in person and virtually with team members to clarify requirements, confirm expected behavior, and communicate quality risks
• Contribute to basic automation, scripting, SQL validation, and repeatable testing practices as assigned
• Use approved AI tools responsibly to support test design, documentation, analysis, and summaries while validating outputs
• Analyze requirements, designs, data, and defects to identify quality risks, gaps, dependencies, and testing priorities
• Develop, maintain, and execute SQL queries, API tests, data validation processes, scripts, and automated test solutions, while continuously enhancing testing assets, frameworks, and overall test efficiency

Requirements:
• Associate's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Quality, or a related technical field required
• Willing to pursue a foundational software quality certification and working toward LOMA level 1 designation
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills
• Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly document and communicate issues
• Ability to learn and apply test automation concepts and tools
• Foundational knowledge of SQL databases, APIs, Agile practices, and test management tools
• Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship

Preferred:
• bachelor's degree preferred
• 1+ years of experience in quality assurance, software testing, technical support, business systems, programming, or a related technology field preferred
• Exposure to software development and testing tools and technologies, including:
• C#
• PowerShell
• Visual Studio
• SQL
• Selenium
• Git
• Playwright
• Experience supporting the development, testing, implementation, or maintenance of software applications preferred
